hypothesis: Fresh C29 source episodes yield enough within-state mixed outcomes across at least three LIBERO suites while preserving a real post-action observation for every branch, enabling action-conditioned future/value training without dropping fast successes.
single_variable: Within each bit-exact restored state, only the first-replan policy diffusion seed changes; the first action executes for 32 steps, and every continuation uses the same replan8 seed schedule.
parent_baseline: C29 fixed D0-H32-s14000 source expansion passed with 61 fresh successful trial4..7 episodes; C28 static H3-action ranking failed on previously consumed episodes.

references.title: FACT: A Failure-Aware Causal Transformer for World Action Models

architecture.paper: Future state, value and video condition on the clean executed action.
architecture.upstream_code: FACT uses a clean-action K/V slot; MiniWorld aligns action chunks to video latent time.
architecture.local: C30 records exact current state, clean executed 32-step action and its real post-action observation for a later temporal consequence adapter.
architecture.rationale: C30 is the data prerequisite and does not yet fit the adapter.

data.paper: Failure rollouts retain future and value supervision.
data.upstream_code: Observed future targets are trained for success and failure episodes.
data.local: Four candidate first actions are rolled out from 122 states across 61 fresh source episodes; every trajectory must contain terminal observations.
data.rationale: The observed consequence is never used as critic input at candidate selection time.

action.paper: The executed action chunk conditions future targets.
action.upstream_code: FACT clean action tokens are K/V-only; MiniWorld groups four actions per latent frame.
action.local: The exact result/trajectory-matched environment-domain 32x7 action is retained, with first chunk32 and continuation replan8.
action.rationale: Temporal tokenization occurs only during later model training.

objective.upstream_code: Training consumes real future observations and failure value labels.
objective.local: C30 requires at least 10 train and 4 untouched validation mixed groups across at least three suites plus 488/488 valid consequence observations.
objective.rationale: No optimization is authorized unless the causal data gate passes.

optimization.paper: World/action/value parameters train after data assembly.
optimization.local: C30 updates zero parameters and runs 488 simulator branches on 32 GPUs.

evaluation.paper: Generalization is evaluated on held-out rollouts.
evaluation.upstream_code: Evaluation episodes are distinct from training records.
evaluation.local: 45 train and 16 validation source episodes are suite-stratified and frozen before branch outcomes; terminal/replan consequence fields are hard audited.
evaluation.rationale: This gate authorizes training but is not itself an effect result.

evidence: terminal observation and temporal consequence code fixed before C30 outcomes
first chunk32; continuation replan8; candidate seed only first replan
45/16 source split frozen before branch outcomes

decision.rationale: C29 provides sufficient new source episodes, and C30 closes the terminal-observation bias before any action-conditioned consequence training.

result.boundary: All mechanical and consequence fields passed, but the fixed validation requirement was >=4 mixed groups and only 3 occurred. The threshold is not relaxed post hoc; C31 formal training remains blocked.
